title: Development and internal validation of an interpretable machine learning-based risk stratification model for sarcopenic obesity in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
summary: Interpretable ML models including LightGBM and XGBoost stratify sarcopenic obesity risk in a 378-patient single-centre T2DM cohort with internal validation and calibration.
ai_technology: Interpretable LightGBM and XGBoost models for sarcopenic-obesity risk stratification.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A 378-patient single-centre T2DM cohort was split for model development and internal validation; calibration and discrimination were assessed for sarcopenic-obesity risk.
evidence.unknown: External generalization, independent replication and downstream real-world impact were not established by the reviewed source.
evidence.ai_role: LightGBM and XGBoost models use clinical variables to estimate sarcopenic-obesity risk in patients with type 2 diabetes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
